ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity pixels (black/dark grey) comprise approximately 85% of the visible surface area, with high-intensity pixels (white/light grey) comprising the remaining 15%, localized primarily at distal extremities and within linear scarring.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white regions are mapped to the distal 10-15% of the left and right fluke lobes; numerous discrete white linear segments are distributed across the central and right-medial surface areas.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped notch with an approximate interior angle of 130 degrees and a depth of roughly 1/8th the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the entire trailing boundary, with a notable increase in peak sharpness on the right lobe edge compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve following a smooth outward trajectory from the median notch, tapering to pointed distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized cluster of circular high-contrast white spots concentrated at the extreme distal margin of the left lobe, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white linear marks (rake marks) visible; a primary cluster of 5-7 roughly parallel lines is mapped to the right-central lobe, with secondary individual lines on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent multi-line rake marks across the right lobe and center-left; irregular, textured protrusion at the extreme right distal tip indicating significant localized scarring or calcification.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense, crisscrossing pattern of rake marks on the medial-right lobe surface provides a unique spatial identifier.
